unmatched.problem: Hindi says the meeting has taken place at 3, not that it was moved to 3 pm.
unmatched.why: The meaning changes from the en/te source.
unmatched.fix: Use: मीटिंग अब दोपहर 3 बजे होगी।

unmatched.quote: It never got tired, and it never used common sense either
unmatched.problem: Describes the program as having tiredness and common sense with no stated break point.
unmatched.why: Art. 7 asks for a break point whenever human traits are used for AI.
unmatched.fix: Rephrase as plain mechanical behaviour: it repeats the same steps the same way every time and has no sense of what a message means.

unmatched.quote: localeStatus: draft; hi and te are unreviewed drafts
unmatched.problem: Hindi and Telugu are unreviewed drafts and carry several divergences from English.
unmatched.why: Art. 11 says translations are reviewed by native speakers; they must not reach learners unreviewed.
unmatched.fix: Run native-speaker review for hi and te after English fixes are made.

unmatched.problem: Emoji symbols have no text alternatives, and some do not match their messages (🏏 on the Muslim-names message, 📘 on the homework message).
unmatched.why: Screen readers may announce the emoji redundantly or oddly; mismatches confuse meaning.
unmatched.fix: Mark the symbols decorative or give alt text, and match them to the corrected messages.
